Each prepares in381 bounded units, scrambles disposable warm RAM, validates the
saved payload/provider, restores exactly the three documented warm extents,
then transfers through the fresh0900 thunk to0A00 and actual resident idle.
STATE1534 bytes are only one part of the48152-byte warm payload: OBJECTS cache
state17 and DOCSTATE ring96 are included in the larger snapshot. Their exact
bytes, full canonical source/history/hot state, settings/catalog, ReadyOS1024,
and the entire16MiB are checked. Capture may change only the actual ownerFC
payload[0,BC18) and header[BC20,BC60); source53 is wholly read-only.

Every case also invokes real C29 BEGIN with foreign `se_f_owner=64`: Cset/D5,
full1152-byte opaque phase unchanged, owner retained, and wholeREU unchanged.
This phase-owner64 test is **not** a test of the separately reserved global

## Mask/lifecycle review for promotion

* C29/R26 preserves the entire BC flag byte, observer17, and ring96. Resume
  clears executable/derived UI authority but does not mint or drop semantic
  authority, erase an unread event, or reset128's per-baseline attempt policy.
* H_INIT starts a genuinely new source context by storing whole flags2. This
  legitimately clears64/128; unused stale ring bytes are not authority when
  head/tail/count are0. The verified fresh R33 baseline also clears128.
* C12 retirement removes ARMED/PAGE_PROOF and sets LOST only after checked
  release, preserving ticket/incarnation/ring/128 until H_INIT.
* R19's strict carry mask allows the explicitly private128 attempt bit while
  refusing reserved64. Lexical R36/R37/C47/C49 source guards mask the low0F
  lifetime bits and do not assign meaning to64. This release does not test or
  approve a live global64 reader-revocation protocol. If64 is introduced for
  that purpose, lexical borrowed-reader guards must join that protocol before
  claiming coexistence; adding64 to their existing mask operands looks like a
  byte-neutral implementation route, but is not implemented or qualified here.

No production fix was needed for the tested source/lifecycle contract. Initial
harness errors are retained: missing real clipboard initialization, trying to
reuse overwritten cold initialization after fresh bootstrap, assuming a queued
edit immediately implies LOST, old history fresh-ID0 instead of1, and adapter
method signature/MRO collisions. They were not treated as product failures or
used to relax any payload/foreign-memory guard. All8 final CPU images were
inspected through hash-identical reviewed ancestry/contact evidence.
